init.title: Sekurak – alarm triggers
init.description:
Pick entities that start each alarm (alarm_control_panel on triggered, others on on). Multiple allowed.

The silence webhook is one-time: each alarm gets a new random ID that stops working after silencing (max 15 min). Address pattern: {webhook_url}

data.secret: Secret (same as in the app, empty = none)
data.external_url: HA external address, as in the Companion App (empty = from HA settings / Nabu Casa)
